title: designing-tech-lead-handoff input contract
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage tl-design.

epics.description: engine-hydrated: the ba-brief manifest's epic refs dereferenced into inline epic sidecar objects (elaborating-user-stories schemas/epic-sidecar.json). Epic ids match ^EPIC-[A-Z0-9-]+$.

story_files.description: The manifest's original story file refs, retained alongside the hydrated stories.

stories.description: engine-hydrated: inline story sidecar objects (elaborating-user-stories schemas/story-sidecar.json). Story ids match ^STORY-[A-Z0-9-]+-\d+$ and carry banking_grade_concerns force-fill rows.

governance_gaps.description: BA governance gaps; any entry with blocks_tl_handoff:true stops the design (BLOCK-P1-GOVERNANCE).

tokens_path.description: ux-intake pack-relative POSIX path (ux-design-{idem8}/tokens.json). Resolve via dirname(upstream_artifacts["ux-intake"]); reject absolute paths and .. traversal.

route_map_path.description: ux-intake pack-relative POSIX path. Same resolution and traversal rules as tokens_path.

component_inventory_path.description: ux-intake pack-relative POSIX path (producer-required as of generate-ux-pack 0.2.0).

pack_dir.description: The ux-intake pack directory name; consumers verify every ux path is contained within it.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key (same key + same inputs => same design).

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir. Basis for resolving the ux pack-relative paths and reading the ba-brief INDEX manifest (state must be ready-for-tl).

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): plan-review loop_back findings threaded into the re-run; the revised design must address them.
